title: Aramaic Papyri of the Fifth Century B.C.

verification_log.method: No. 30 (pp. 108–114): letter of Yedoniah and the priests of Yeb to Bigvai, governor of Judah, about the destroyed temple; line 18: "Johanan the high priest and his colleagues the priests who are in Jerusalem"; line 29: a letter sent "to Delaiah and Shelemiah the sons of Sanballat governor of Samaria"; line 30: "the 20th of Marheshwan, the 17th year of Darius the king" (Cowley: Darius II = 408 B.C.); Cowley: Nehemiah's Sanballat is "no doubt" the same; since Bigvai was governor in 408 the 32nd year of Neh 13:6 must be Artaxerxes I = 433 B.C., "a fixed point in the history of Nehemiah"; Johanan of Neh 12:22–23; Josephus telescopes the history; No. 21: no evidence identifies Hananiah of the Passover letter with any Hananiah of Nehemiah

access_notes: Read through the Internet Archive OCR text (No. 30 and its introduction; No. 21 introduction).
